note: App-UI documentation shots (DD-031 docs/demo parity). Unlike shots.manifest.json (mid-grey capability RENDERS), these capture the actual Feature Lab APPLICATION surface — the control/inspector rail, color-mode selector, tabs, diagnostics, and the Preview/Prepare modes — so the README/docs show the interactive product, not just pretty renders. Driven by capture-app.mjs against the running Feature Lab (tools/demo, :5199). The studio-dark chrome IS the product look (not the mid-grey capture look).

shots.name: app-control-panel
shots.caption: The Feature Lab: the inspector rail (move-visibility toggles, feature-role hide, segment inspection) beside a 3DBenchy colored by feature role, with the layer/segment scrub and honest capability badges.
shots.alt: The G-code Preview Feature Lab application — a 3DBenchy colored by feature role in the viewport, a floating feature-role legend, camera controls, a layers/segments/time scrub strip, an inspector rail with move-visibility toggles, and capability badges (featureRoles known, feedrate known) in the status bar

shots.name: app-appearance
shots.caption: The Appearance tab: the color-mode selector (single / tool / feature / speed / object / layer height / …), each capability-gated to what the file can prove, with the active legend.
shots.alt: The Feature Lab Appearance tab showing the color-by selector with feature role active, a legend of outer wall / inner wall / infill / support colors, and color modes greyed out when the file can't support them

shots.name: app-diagnostics
shots.caption: The Diagnostics tab reading getRenderStats(): backend (hardware vs software WebGL), GPU, geometry mode, segment/vertex counts, draw calls, and timings — honest nulls, never guesses.
shots.alt: The Feature Lab Diagnostics tab showing render diagnostics — backend 3d-webgl, geometry tubes, segment and draw-call counts, and the GPU renderer string — plus capability confidence badges

shots.name: app-prepare
shots.caption: Prepare mode: interactive source-model viewing (STL / 3MF) — the same app viewing a colored 3MF before slicing, with the honest materials capability tier and object/placement counts.
shots.alt: The Feature Lab in Prepare mode showing a colored 3MF source model (red, amber, green stacked blocks), a Source Model panel reporting 3 objects, 3 placements, and materials: known, and camera controls
